newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: LG Semicon to make Java chips.
newsitem.headline: LG Semicon to make Java chips.

text.p: South Korean chip maker LG Semicon Co said on Friday it had signed an agreement to be co-developers of Sun Microsystems Inc's Java processor.
It said in a statement it would also collaborate on the next generation of Java chips.
The Java chip is designed for the Java programming language which can be used to create applications for different computer systems, including consumer electronic devices.
LG Semicon will manufacture the Java processors while Sun will be the worldwide exclusive distributor.
The processors are expected to be available in the fourth quarter of 1997, the statement said.
It said the two companies expected the processor to be used in various consumer appliances such as network computers, Internet televisions and set-top boxes in early 1998.
LG Semicon is a unit of South Korea's LG Group.
